Ond now runs on Linux and Windows as well as macOS.

### Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `Ond-0.2.0-macos-universal.dmg` (or `.zip`) | macOS 11 or later, Apple silicon and Intel |
| `Ond-0.2.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Linux on x86_64, glibc 2.39 or newer (Ubuntu 24.04, Fedora 40, Debian 13) |
| `Ond-0.2.0-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | Linux on ARM64, same requirements |
| `Ond-0.2.0-windows-x86_64.zip` | Windows 10 and 11. **Untested.** See below. |

On NixOS or with Nix: `nix profile install github:Solidsilver/ond/v0.2.0`. Install steps for every platform are in the [README](https://github.com/Solidsilver/ond#install).

### Windows is untested

The Windows build compiles and passes the full test suite on CI, but nobody has run it on a real Windows machine yet. Expect rough edges. If you try it, please [open an issue](https://github.com/Solidsilver/ond/issues) with what worked and what didn't. That's the fastest way to get it to the same level as the other two.

### Linux

- Plays through PipeWire directly, with ALSA as the fallback.
- Media keys, the GNOME and KDE media controls, and the lock screen work through MPRIS, with cover art.
- The window draws its own title bar and follows your desktop's button layout (close only on GNOME, or minimize, maximize and close).
- Two-finger trackpad scrolling coasts after you lift your fingers, as in GTK apps.
- Uses the system UI font and the password keyring (GNOME Keyring or KWallet).
- A Nix flake with a package, an overlay and a `nix develop` shell.

### Windows

- Media keys and the Windows media overlay work through System Media Transport Controls.
- Uses Segoe UI, with Yu Gothic for Japanese, Chinese and Korean text.

### macOS

- The app icon is full size in the Dock and Launchpad on macOS 26 and later (it was shrunk onto a grey tile).

### Everywhere

- Window modes handle maximized windows: going to the Player or Mini un-maximizes first, and the full window comes back maximized.
- Keyboard shortcuts show as Ctrl, Alt and Shift on Linux and Windows.
- The play button on album covers works again.
- Less empty space between lists and the scroll bar.
- A long album name in the Player stays on one line instead of pushing the controls down.
